events.title: Volunteer in the Historic Orchard with UC Master Gardeners!
Volunteer in the Historic Orchard with UC Master Gardeners!

cases.refreshed: The Historic Orchard is a 3.3-acre site planted in 1994 and located in Guadalupe Gardens just south of Taylor Street, adjacent to the Heritage Rose Garden and River Park trails. In the 1930s and '40s, almost everyone who lived here was engaged in the business of fruit production: growing, picking, packing, canning, selling, or otherwise supporting the industry. Today, with very few orchards remaining, this is a place where adults and children can come to experience a piece of local history. Fruit harvested from the Historic Orchard is donated to Second Harvest of Silicon Valley and local shelters. Help us maintain the River Park's Historic Orchard with activities including tree planting and pruning; disease diagnosis and treatment; sun scald prevention painting; sheet mulching; experimenting with different types of irrigation or ground cover; and grafting for improved pollination. Chaperones are required for those age 15 and younger. School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events. Restrooms are available at the Rotary Play Garden and will require staff assistance. Address for parking: 438 Coleman Ave. Jose, CA 95110; Meeting location: Historic Orchard (refer to the registration form for a map); Time: 9:30 AM - 11:30 AM; Recurring dates: Every Wednesday

events.title: Volunteer in the Heritage Rose Garden!
Volunteer in the Heritage Rose Garden!

cases.refreshed: Help us revitalize the largest public rose collection in the Western Hemisphere! Tasks include weeding, deadheading, pruning, and seasonal planting. We suggest bringing a full water bottle and thick work gloves. Chaperones are required for those age 15 and younger. School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events. Restrooms are available at the Rotary Play Garden starting at 10 AM. We highly recommend using the restrooms prior to volunteering. Address for parking: 438 Coleman Ave. Jose, CA 95110; Meeting location: Rose Garden Shed (refer to the registration form for a map); Time: 8:30 AM - 11:30 AM; Recurring dates: Every Saturday

cases.refreshed: Join us for an afternoon of gardening and grow your skills with guidance from our UC Master Gardener–certified horticulturist! You'll have the chance to learn and practice a wide range of seasonal tasks, including planting, weeding, deadheading, mulching, irrigation, pruning, and more—all while giving a little love back to the beautiful Guadalupe Gardens. We suggest bringing a full water bottle and thick work gloves. Chaperones are required for those age 15 and younger. School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events. Address for parking: 438 Coleman Ave. Jose, CA 95110; Meeting location: Rose Garden Shed (refer to the registration form for a map); Time: 3:30 PM - 5:00 PM; Recurring dates: Every second and fourth Friday of the month
